title: Enterprise Connectivity: portfolio spending threshold
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following portfolio spending threshold for each named contract tier. Same-category posted pre-discount usage subtotal required within one billing entity and month for volume discount; USD decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | portfolio spending threshold | 25000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | portfolio spending threshold | 25000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | portfolio spending threshold | 25000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | portfolio spending threshold | 25000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | portfolio spending threshold | 25000 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | portfolio spending threshold | 25000 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the portfolio spending threshold is 25000.
